notes: Read SKILL.md in full. The skill is a command reference for AWS S3 (buckets, copy/sync, versioning, bucket policies, lifecycle rules, logging) and self-hosted MinIO (docker run/compose, mc client operations).

Following it can make the agent run state-changing commands against real storage using the user's configured AWS/MinIO credentials, including destructive ones: aws s3 rb --force (SKILL.md:52, labelled destructive), aws s3 rm --recursive (:86), aws s3 sync --delete (:71), and permanent version deletion (:110-113). These are listed as reference operations for tasks the user asks for, not as steps the agent should run on its own, so medium risk is acceptable; destructive commands should be confirmed with the user.

SKILL.md:293-294 downloads the mc binary from dl.min.io without checksum verification and moves it into /usr/local/bin; users should verify the download. Credentials in examples are placeholders (minioadmin / minio-secret-key-change-me, AKIAEXAMPLE). The bucket policy grants public read only to the static/ prefix. Related skills are named in plain text only.
